integrity: All formula proofs are self-contained, reproducibility checker is included; finite computations corroborate but do not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime dihedral orders and nonmodular finite fields. The count concerns products of two equal algebra elements and not higher nonassociative nilpotency. Earlier general Fourier product identities are acknowledged; exact priority beyond inspected literature remains unconfirmed.
title: Square-zero elements of prime dihedral quandle algebras: a Frobenius-cycle census
